title: Balanced Crates Quark Sorting
description: Add Quark inventory sorting button to Balanced Crates
body:
Balanced Crates is a neat mod that adds a more practical way to store and manage items, especially if you like having crate-style storage in your world.

Unfortunately, Quark’s inventory sorting button does not normally appear in the Balanced Crates GUI, which means you lose one of Quark’s most convenient quality-of-life features when using these crates.

This mod fixes that by adding Quark’s sorting button to the Balanced Crates interface.

It also slightly adjusts the button placement so Quark’s sorting button does not overlap with Balanced Crates’ own button.
